positions.as_written: Measure alignment on a long leg film in any knee with coronal laxity, because the two together decide the treatment.
Expect laxity and alignment to drive each other, which is the argument for correcting alignment alongside any lateral reconstruction.
Treat varus as a system rather than a sign.
Correct alignment before or with a lateral reconstruction in a varus limb, and say so in the plan rather than treating it as optional.
Measure on weight bearing films, since a supine measurement describes an unloaded knee.
Avoid reconstructing laxity in a limb whose alignment caused it.
